title: I wanted to love this set.  I did when I first saw it
text:
I wanted to love this set. I did when I first saw it. I was very disappointed to find the flour canister's seal doesn't seal. The top comes off very easily. You can feel the seal on the middle size canister. You have to give it a tug to pull it off. The flour doesn't work this way.

Another disappointment is the cannister that is supposed to be for coffee. It only holds about 2 cups. No way can a bag of coffee fit in there.

It is a pretty set, just not as functional as it should be.
